Coram : ASHOK BHAN*, DALVEER BHANDARI
Land Acquisition: C Land Acquisition Act, 1894: Sections 4 and 6. "Public purpose "-Acquisition of premises-State Government issued a notification under S. 4 and declaration under S. 6 for acquisition of premises for the office-cum-residence for the Deputy Commissioner of Police D in question for more than six decades-In the declaration it was clearly incorporated that the premises in question was required at the public expense-The said premises and the land appurtenant thereto had been continuously in possession of the state Government Since 1943 as the office of the Dy.
Decision Date : 13-11-2006 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 6756/2003 | Disposal Nature : Dismissed | Bench : 2 Judges
